Name: Farm x N - Custom Farm Map Editor
Author: ifuwasacat
Description:
[size=5][b]Farm x N — Your farm, now with a commute.[/b][/size]
Pick any Standard Farm size, move the landmarks, and export Farm.tmx from your browser.

[b][url=https://link1412.github.io/FarmxN/]OPEN THE ONLINE EDITOR[/url][/b] | [url=https://github.com/link1412/FarmxN]Source[/url]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Any size from 80 × 65 to 4096 × 4096 (up to Farm x 3226 by total map area). Opens at 160 × 130.[/*]
[*]Move the farmhouse, greenhouse, cave, Grandpa's shrine, shipping bin, pet bowl and the three exits.[/*]
[*]Export checks terrain, overlaps and walking routes.[/*]
[*]English and Chinese; autosave, undo/redo, arrow-key nudging.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Downloads[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Offline Editor 2.1.0[/b]: unzip and open index.html. It's a tool, not a mod; keep it out of Mods.[/*]
[*][b]Default 2048 × 2048 Farm 2.0.0[/b]: ready-to-use Content Patcher map pack (Farm x 806.6).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI 4 and Content Patcher (Stardew Valley 1.6).
2. Put [CP] FarmxN in Mods.
3. Start a [b]new Standard Farm[/b].
To use your own map, export Farm.tmx from the editor and replace:
[code]Mods/[CP] FarmxN/assets/Farm.tmx[/code][size=4][b]Before you play[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Back up your saves. Existing buildings, crops and objects don't move with the map.[/*]
[*]Don't combine with other mods that replace Maps/Farm.[/*]
[*]Maps over 2048 × 2048 need several GB of memory and load slowly; a 4096 × 4096 TMX is about 240 MB.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Future plans[/b][/size]
Support for other farm types.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
By ifuwasacat / link1412. Stardew Valley artwork and map data belong to ConcernedApe and are not covered by the ISC license. Thanks to SMAPI and Content Patcher.

[size=4][b]中文说明[/b][/size]
[b]Farm x N：农场大到，上班也算通勤。[/b]
在浏览器里自定义标准农场尺寸（80 × 65 到 4096 × 4096，默认 160 × 130），移动房屋、温室、洞穴、爷爷的神龛等设施和三个出口，导出 Farm.tmx。中英文界面，自动保存，可撤销重做。
[list]
[*][b]离线编辑器 2.1.0[/b]：解压后打开 index.html，不要放进 Mods。[/*]
[*][b]默认 2048 × 2048 地图 2.0.0[/b]：Content Patcher 地图包，放进 Mods 即可。[/*]
[/list]需要 SMAPI 4 和 Content Patcher，新建标准农场。用自己的地图：导出 Farm.tmx，替换 Mods/[CP] FarmxN/assets/Farm.tmx。
请先备份存档；已有建筑、作物和物件不会随地图搬动。超过 2048 × 2048 的地图需要较多内存，加载较慢。
未来计划：支持其他农场类型。
